name: Chengdu Jiachi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Jiachi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the design, testing, analysis, and manufacture of electromagnetic radiation functional materials and structures in China. The company offers absorbing patch, absorbing rubber sheet, functional coating, wave-absorbing foam, absorbing honeycomb, absorbing load, and magnetic substrate products. It serves military and civilian-related sectors. Chengdu Jiachi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is based in Chengdu, China.
